description: This file defines the LeaveTypeService class within the OrangeHRM HR management system. It provides methods for retrieving leave type data, including eligible leave types for an employee, and converting leave type objects into normalized arrays for use in other parts of the application.

classes.name: LeaveTypeService
classes.description: Service class for managing leave types, including fetching and normalizing leave type data, and determining eligible leave types for employees.

methods.name: getLeaveTypeDao
methods.description: Lazily initializes and returns the LeaveTypeDao instance for database operations related to leave types.

methods.name: getEligibleLeaveTypesByEmpNumber
methods.description: Retrieves a list of leave types for which an employee is eligible, optionally including leave types with allocated leaves.

methods.name: getLeaveTypeAsArray
methods.description: Fetches a leave type by ID and returns its normalized array representation, appending a 'deleted' label if applicable.
